name: pin_upstream_images
conclusion_quantitative: pin_upstream_images (Escalate) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 2 autonomy limits, 2 approval gates, 7 validation rules, 2 escalation rules; none for clarification rules. Strongest: validation rules.
conclusion_qualitative: pin_upstream_images updates the pinned multigres image tags for an operator release and reviews the upstream changes between versions for impact on the operator. Its largest group of rules are evidence-based checks: code searches, flag and environment-variable audits and a deployment smoke test. Operator code changes need the user's explicit permission, and failures are reported to the user. It sets no clarification rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 2 autonomy limits (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, none tied to a situation, evenly split between running text and a bullet point. The agent never changes the etcd image, and when action-required items are found it makes no code changes and runs no smoke tests on its own.

statements.quote: Do NOT modify DefaultEtcdImage -- it uses a separate versioned release.
Do NOT make code changes. Do NOT run smoke tests.

clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to ask the user for missing or unclear information, or to avoid guessing.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 2 approval gates (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, none tied to a situation, all bullet points. The agent presents the action-required items, asks the user for permission to fix them, and waits for explicit approval before editing any operator code beyond the image defaults.

statements.quote: Present the action-required items clearly and ask the user for permission to proceed with the fixes.
Wait for explicit user approval before editing any operator code beyond `image_defaults.go`.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 7 validation rules (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly prose.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 7 rules, all strict, 2 tied to a situation, mostly running text. Every recommendation must rest on a concrete search of the operator code rather than speculation; per-container analysis and audits of CLI flags and environment variables are mandatory, and the agent does not finish until all pods in the smoke test are healthy.

statements.quote: **Do not speculate.** Every recommendation must be backed by a concrete search result (or confirmed absence) in the operator codebase.
**This step is mandatory.** Independent of the diff review above, mechanically verify that every CLI flag the operator passes to upstream components still exists.
mechanically verify that every environment variable required by upstream components is set on the **correct operator container(s)**.
**Only run this when confident no operator code changes are needed**
**Do NOT proceed to Step 6 until all pods are healthy.**

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 2 escalation rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, 1 tied to a situation, evenly split between running text and a bullet point. If the images are already up to date the agent tells the user and stops, and if smoke-test pods fail it reports the issue and asks for permission before fixing.

statements.quote: If old and new SHAs are identical for all images, inform the user that images are already up to date and stop.
Report the issue to the user and ask for permission before applying fixes
